# Air-cooled water chillers, KX range (extract)

Ratings at 35 °C outdoor air.

| Unit  | Duty         |                    |                   | Electrical       |      |
|       | Cooling [kW] | Heat rejected [kW] | Water flow [m³/h] | Power input [kW] | COP  |
|-------|--------------|--------------------|-------------------|------------------|------|
| KX-40 | 41.5         | 54.6               | 7.1               | 13.2             | 3.14 |
| KX-55 | 56.0         | 73.9               | 9.6               | 17.9             | 3.13 |
| KX-70 | 69.8         | 92.5               | 12.0              | 22.6             | 3.09 |

Water flow is the nominal flow for a 5 K range. Below 4 °C leaving water the unit needs glycol.
